CFML Language Reference: Functions

DateConvert

Converts local server time to UTC, or UTC to local server time, using the server's time zone settings.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DateConvert(conversionType, date)

Parameters

conversionType
local2Utc to convert local time to UTC, or utc2Local for the reverse. Case does not matter.
date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

The converted date/time value.

Usage

KoldFusion applies the server's offset from UTC as it is right now (including daylight saving time if it is in effect today), whatever the season of the date you pass. Any other conversion type throws an "Invalid conversion type." error. See GetTimeZoneInfo for the offset itself and GetHTTPTimeString for HTTP-style GMT strings.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Local = Now()>
<CFSET UTC = DateConvert("local2Utc", Local)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Server local time</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(Local, "HH:mm:ss")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>UTC</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(UTC, "HH:mm:ss")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Back to local</TD><TD>#TimeFormat(DateConvert("utc2Local", UTC), "HH:mm:ss")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

GetTimeZoneInfo, GetHTTPTimeString, Now
